tasksNotApplicable.build: Ships base.json and react-library.json verbatim. JSON has no compile step, and inventing one would only copy files.
tasksNotApplicable.lint: Publishes no JavaScript or TypeScript. The only .ts/.tsx files are the compiler fixtures under __checks__/, which exist as input to typecheck and are never imported or shipped.
tasksNotApplicable.test: No runtime behaviour to assert. The failure mode these files actually have -- a typo or an incoherent compiler option -- is caught by typecheck, which compiles a fixture against each config.
